This can lead to selecting an arbitrary officeholder and a wrong year. They should confirm the death city and then determine when the Governor office for that city was abolished (e.g., Rome 1944 or Vatican City 2001), not a specific person’s term. Including “Mayor of Rome” is also unnecessary.
